source:
“You must find me no matter what because this is our last game.”

The mysterious girl who waits for player character.
Seem likes she has deep connection with protagonist.

[spoiler]Her name is Mary Maxwell. Her true identity is protagonist's girlfriend who nearly die because of terminal illness and try to help protagonist to survive in nameless mansion.[/spoiler]
